title: The creepy graduation clue | Conformity Gate Part 2

shots.vo: Conformity Gate, clue number one. In the graduation scene, fans noticed rows of students sitting with their hands folded... the exact same way.
shots.prompt: Rows of anonymous graduates in caps and gowns seated in folding chairs on a school lawn, faces out of focus, slow crane-down over the rows, flat overcast light

shots.vo: Some linked that pose to Henry Creel, the man who became Vecna. Puppets under his control? Or just extras told to sit still?
shots.prompt: Close-up of many pairs of hands folded identically in laps in a row, perfectly still, a faint red vignette creeping in, slow lateral slide

shots.vo: The frame can't prove it either way. But the next clue... is harder to ignore.
shots.prompt: Old peeling floral wallpaper in a dark hallway, a faint shape pressing against it from behind, a single ceiling bulb flickering, slow push-in

caption: Conformity Gate clue #1: why were their hands all folded the same way? Fan theory, not confirmed. Part 3 tomorrow.
